operation.name: OSGB36 to WGS 84 (9)
operation.why: Best stated accuracy (1 m, OSTN15 grid) whose area covers all points in Great Britain; applied via inverse British National Grid (EPSG:27700) to OSGB36 then OSTN15.

assumptions: Eastings/northings read as British National Grid (EPSG:27700, datum OSGB36) in metres.
notes: OSTN15 grid used (confirmed as HORIZONTAL_SHIFT_GTIFF). Operation chosen by accuracy rule; no points outside area.
